observation.date: released 2007-07-31 (observation dates not given on the image page)

processing: Used the archive's 'Large JPEG' (https://cdn.esahubble.org/archives/images/large/heic0712a.jpg), not the TIFF original. Orientation: archive states 'North is 84.8° left of vertical'; converted to upPositionAngleDeg = -84.8 (degrees east of north; 'north X° left of vertical' means up lies X° west of north, so the angle is -X; 'right' gives +X; assumes the image is not mirrored).
Only a tiny (2.5 x 1.25 arcmin) piece of a nebula about 3 degrees across; the whole Veil is NOT covered by any image we could evidence.

Centre: the archive page's 'Position' is the WCS reference value (RA 311.417259°, Dec +30.988061°) at AVM reference pixel (746.0, 375.0) counted from the lower-left; the declared centre is the geometric centre of the image computed from the embedded AVM pixel scale and orientation (offset 0.00 arcmin from the page position). Field of view in the manifest matches the AVM scale x image size.
